content: In the context of the IberEval shared tasks, two related multilingual datasets have been created BIBREF2, BIBREF3. Both are a collection of annotated Spanish and Catalan tweets. Crucially, the tweets in both languages focus on the same issue (Catalan independence); given this fact they are the first truly multilingual stance detection datasets known to us.
